environment.description: Node.js 18.x Express application deployed on EC2 behind a classic ELB (not ALB) in TCP passthrough mode. The ELB forwards raw TCP without HTTP parsing. No WAF. The application's IAM role has full DynamoDB access (dynamodb:*) on the Users table. Security groups allow inbound on port 3000 from 0.0.0.0/0. The internal admin endpoints are intended to be protected by network segmentation but the /internal proxy route is exposed through the same listener.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB in TCP mode (port 3000 passthrough)
